about_the_game:
Ready to become a Border Police Officer? 👮 Step into the world of Black Border 2: Border Patrol Simulator and experience the intense pressure of national security. As a Customs Officer, your duty is to protect the nation from illegal smuggling and Check the Papers, Please! 🕵️‍♂️ Inspect passports, scrutinize documents, and use advanced tools to make life-or-death decisions in this gripping police simulator game. 💥

Take on the duty of a Border Patrol Agent and protect your nation's borders. Your role is crucial and you Must Check every Papers, Please:

🛂 Document Inspection: Meticulously check passports, permits, and papers to approve or reject entrants.

🔎 Advanced Tools: Utilize X-ray scanners to reveal hidden items and weigh stations to check vehicle legitimacy.

🐕 Canine Unit: Deploy your loyal service dog to sniff out concealed contraband and uncover secrets.

⚖️ Strategic Decisions: Every choice you make impacts the safety of your country.
